mapper.insert: INSERT INTO therapist_services (therapist_id, service_id, created_at) VALUES (#{therapistId}, #{serviceId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.name, s.description, s.price, s.duration_minutes, s.active, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM services s INNER JOIN therapist_services ts ON ts.service_id = s.id WHERE ts.therapist_id = #{therapistId} ORDER BY s.id
